entries.title: Proverbs 26:2
segments:
CHAP. XXVI. 
 
  V. 2. By flying-Secures itself from the fowler.  Not come-Upon the innocent person, but he shall escape from it like a bird.

entries.title: Proverbs 26:4
segments: V. 4. According-So as to imitate his folly, by passionate or reproachful speeches.

entries.title: Proverbs 26:5
segments: V. 5. According-So as his folly needs and requires, convincing him strongly, reproving him sharply, and exposing him to just shame.

entries.title: Proverbs 26:6
segments: V. 6. Cutteth off the feet-Of his messenger; bids one go that wants legs.  Drinketh-Drinking, in scripture, frequently denotes the plentiful doing or receiving of any thing.

entries.title: Proverbs 26:7
segments: V. 7. The legs-Heb. the legs of the lame are lifted up, in going, or in dancing, which is done with great inequality and uncomeliness. So-No less incident are wise and pious speeches from a foolish and ungodly man.

entries.title: Proverbs 26:8
segments: V. 8. Bindeth-Whereby he hinders his own design of throwing the stone out of it.  So-No less absurd is he that giveth to a fool that honour which he is not capable of using aright.

entries.title: Proverbs 26:9
segments: V. 9. A thorn-As a thorn is in a drunkard's hand, which he cannot manage cautiously, but employs to his own and others hurt. So-As unprofitable, and, by accident, hurtful to himself and others.

entries.title: Proverbs 26:10
segments: V. 10. Rewardeth-Will certainly give that recompence which is deserved by fools and transgressors, by such as sin either thro' ignorance, or wilfully.

entries.title: Proverbs 26:14
segments: V. 14. Turneth-Moving hither and thither upon it, but not removing from its place.

entries.title: Proverbs 26:16
segments: V. 16. A reason-A satisfactory reason of ail their actions.

entries.title: Proverbs 26:17
segments: V. 17. He-Who is going upon the way.  With strife-In which he is not concerned, nor any way obliged to meddle.  That taketh-Exposes himself to needless hazard.

entries.title: Proverbs 26:18
segments: V. 18. And death-Any instruments of death.

entries.title: Proverbs 26:23
segments: V. 23. Burning-With malice or hatred: A slanderous or evil tongue. Dross-Such a tongue and heart are of no real worth, although sometimes they make a shew of it, as dross does of silver.

entries.title: Proverbs 26:26
segments: V. 26. Deceit-With false professions of love.

entries.title: Proverbs 26:27
segments: V. 27. Rolleth-Up the hill with design to do mischief to some person.
